column3: “by night” renders “night.”
“establish” renders “cause to dwell.”
NASB puts “for you came out … in haste” in parentheses; “leavened bread” renders “leaven.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“You are not allowed” renders “You will not be able”; “towns” renders “gates.”
“establish” renders “cause to dwell”; “at sunset” renders “when the sun goes.”
“return” renders “turn.”
“solemn assembly” renders “assembly”; NASB adds “on it.”
NASB reverses the clause order; “put the sickle to” renders “a sickle begins in.”
“a tribute of a freewill offering” renders “a sufficiency of a freewill offering”; the meaning is uncertain.
“stranger” renders “sojourner,” and “orphan” renders “fatherless one.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“after you have gathered in” renders “when you gather.”
“stranger” renders “sojourner”; “towns” renders “gates.”
“altogether joyful” renders the emphatic “surely joyful.”
“before the LORD” renders “with the presence of the LORD”; the Hebrew verb is “will appear” (also read “will see the face”).
“shall give as he is able” renders “according to the gift of his hand.”
“towns” renders “gates”; “with righteous judgment” renders “judgment of righteousness.”
“be partial” renders “regard faces.”
“Justice, and only justice” renders the repeated “Righteousness, righteousness.”
“an Asherah of any kind of tree” renders “an Asherah, any tree.”
Close to the Hebrew.
